subtitle: Official League options and what Xyra does for you.
optionsHint: The same ones in the League Options menu: Xyra just saves you the search.
noClient: Open League to see and change these options.

WindowMode.title: Borderless
WindowMode.description: Needed to see Xyra labels over the game.

ShowAttackRadius.title: Attack range
ShowAttackRadius.description: Draws how far your basic attacks reach.

MinimapEnableAllTimers.title: Minimap timers
MinimapEnableAllTimers.description: The objective and camp respawn timers built into the game.

FlipMiniMap.title: Minimap on the left
FlipMiniMap.description: Moves the minimap to the other side of the screen.

MinimapScale.title: Minimap size
MinimapScale.description: Bigger reads better on large screens.

automaticHint: Turn it on once and Xyra takes care of it.

keepBorderless.title: Keep Borderless
keepBorderless.description: If the game goes back to fullscreen, Xyra sets Borderless again before your next game.

autoImportRunes.title: Import runes by itself
autoImportRunes.description: In champion select it imports the runes of the champion you got. It only replaces its own page.

closeWindowInGame.title: Close the window while playing
closeWindowInGame.description: When the game starts the window closes and Xyra stays in the tray, using no memory.

safe: All of this uses options League already has: it never touches the game or plays for you.
